[[Lieutenant Major]] '''Pirrell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an officer in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My superior, Colonel Sartius, is an incompetent fool. I toil in his shadow, though his job should rightfully be mine. [...] I have served this Empire with distinction for years--and yet I'm still merely a lieutenant major. Unacceptable.|Lieutenant Major Pirrell|<ref name="TOR:PA" />}}
During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]], he was assistant to the naval attaché of the governor of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and head of intelligence of Imperial military forces on the planet.<ref name="TOR:PA" />

He had an Imperial [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to help him surpass his superior, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sartius]] and to impress Admiral [[Ivernus]]. Little did he know, however, was that this [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] was a competitor in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] and that their target was Ivernus himself.<ref name="TOR:PA" /> Pirrell had this bounty hunter cause many mishaps on Sartius's missions, causing Ivernus to personally come to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to execute Pirrell, instead of promoting him. This opportunity allowed the hunter to eliminate Ivernus.<ref name="TOR:MtA" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
After Pirrell found out about the hunter's true intentions, he attempted to escape, however the hunter [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="TOR:MtA" />
{{Endgame}}
